high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a text-based article about John McCarthy, a significant figure in the field of computing. The text is divided into two main sections. The first section discusses John McCarthy's contributions to computing. It mentions that he was the first to describe the time-sharing model of computing in 1961. He suggested that if this approach were adopted, "the day is near when computing may be organized as a public utility, similar to the telephone system that is a public utility." According to him, this could be the foundation for a significant new industry.
